title: Header names overwritten to Content-Type
detail: The loop sets `name = "Content-Type"` for every header whose name is not already "content-type", causing all custom headers to be renamed to "Content-Type". This corrupts request headers and can break clients that rely on other headers.
note: Describes the planted flip: every other header is renamed to Content-Type.

title: Blocking read on keep‑alive
detail: When the connection is keep‑alive, the body may be empty. Calling `stream.read()` will block waiting for data that never arrives, causing the server to hang.

title: Potential stream leak on keep‑alive
detail: The `_reset` method resets the parser but does not close the stream when the connection is keep‑alive. If the parser is fully complete, the stream remains open, leading to a resource leak.
